notes.title: Alien Day 2025 - OpenCAGE v0.14
notes.notes:
[b]Script Editor[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated websocket/syncing logic to send additional metadata to the level viewer
[*]Added setup process to install components required for the level editor
[*]Added ability to launch the level viewer with options
[*]Reworked default parameter population to more accurately populate default values
[*]Added additional metadata to variable entities to specify the type of node pin they are intended for
[*]Reworked "special string" selection into "enum string" datatype for more explicit autofill
[*]Added more enum string options ("list" values in the docs)
[*]Animations are now populated contextually based on AnimationSet
[*]Improved load times when selecting a string
[*]Included additional parameter names for CAGEAnimation entities
[*]Expanded enum dropdown input support (removes need for manual indexes)
[*]Enum type now only selectable if not pre-defined
[*]Create node option no longer shown if not in flowgraph mode
[*]Checking a parameter/pin is now respected even if hidden by search
[*]Function entities now receive default names based on their function type
[*]Integer and float parameter inputs now use numeric up/down fields
[*]Composite names now correctly cased
[*]Fixed many smaller bugs and usability issues
[/list]

[b]Level Viewer[/b]
[list]
[*]Now included with OpenCAGE! Follow the setup guide [url=https://opencage.co.uk/docs/level-viewer/]here[/url].
[*]Added syncing with the Script Editor (live-mirror added/removed/repositioned/updated entities)
[*]Reworked editor script to hide all windows except Scene, and open correct scene with correct lighting setup
[*]Removed support for loading textures (only shader colours now used)
[/list]

[b]Launch Game[/b]
[list]
[*]Added an option to disable the "current gen" flag ([url=https://github.com/MattFiler/OpenCAGE/wiki/Launch-Game#patch-current-gen-optimisations]more info[/url])
[/list]

[b]Other Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where offline assets weren't tracked correctly and were always considered outdated
[*]Updater will now force-close Unity to prevent conflicts when updating the Level Viewer
[*]Fixed a rogue file lock issue in the updater
[/list]

notes.title: OpenCAGE is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
In development since 2017, OpenCAGE is a suite of open-source community-created mod tools for the game Alien: Isolation which open the door to the creation of custom campaigns, maps, models, and various game configurations. Today, it's arriving on Steam for the first time, making it easier than ever to get involved with an awesome community building new experiences inside one of the greatest horror games ever made!

OpenCAGE contains various editors which you can launch from the main landing screen, these are the:
[list]
[*][b]Asset editor[/b] - A tool to import/export textures, models, UI, and animations
[*][b]Configuration editor[/b] - A tool to modify a range of game configurations (including weapons, ammo, NPC viewcones and locomotion, player attributes, and more)
[*][b]Cathode script editor[/b] - A tool allowing full access to the game's scripting system (including level population, missions, characters, weapons, and more)
[*][b]Behaviour tree editor[/b] - A tool giving full access to every behaviour tree in the game
[*][b]Launch game tool[/b] - Functionality to launch the game directly to a level with various optional extras (including Cinematic Tools, debug helpers, and more)
[/list]
There's also functionality for creating/managing/restoring backups of levels, and reverting configurations and behaviour trees.

If you have Alien: Isolation installed via Steam, install OpenCAGE to the same Steam library folder and you're good to go. If you've installed the game from a different source (Epic, or GoG), OpenCAGE will ask you to locate it when you first start up the toolkit.

To learn more about the tools, check out the [url=https://opencage.co.uk/docs/]documentation site[/url], and join the [url=https://discord.gg/JJ4ECu9hpY]Discord[/url]!

OpenCAGE continues to be expanded and developed over time - if you're interested in contributing to the project, check out the [url=https://github.com/MattFiler/OpenCAGE]GitHub page[/url] to learn more!

Future planned functionality includes support for sound editors, 3D visualisers, and improvements to the configuration editor UIs. Please drop any feature requests or bugs over on the [url=https://github.com/MattFiler/OpenCAGE/issues]GitHub issues[/url] page!

Follow the creator MattFiler on [url=https://twitter.com/mattfiler]X (Twitter)[/url] or [url=https://bsky.app/profile/mattfiler.co.uk]Bluesky[/url] for future news and updates.


[i]OpenCAGE is in no way related to (or endorsed by) Creative Assembly or SEGA.
Alien: Isolation must be purchased and installed to use OpenCAGE.[/i]
